description: Queue up to 100 URLs as one asynchronous job and collect the results later by batch_id, so a large list never blocks your run. Use when you have more than 20 URLs or do not need results immediately; for 2-20 URLs with results now use alterlab_batch_scrape. Cost: the alterlab_scrape rate per URL, from $0.0002 up to $0.02. Each URL can have its own mode, formats and extraction_schema. Returns a batch_id immediately; results are available from GET /api/v1/batch/{batch_id}. The response lists one `jobs` entry per submitted URL in submission order, each with a job_id or a rejection (scope, reason, retry_after_seconds); `job_ids` holds the accepted subset and is not positional, so pair ids with URLs through `jobs`. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

approval_id.description: Approval for work above the key's approval_above_usd threshold. Such work returns status pending_approval with an approval_url and next_action; show the URL to your human, then resubmit the identical request with the approval_id once alterlab_approval reports approved.

dry_run.description: Free estimate only: returns per-item predicted tier and cost, totals in microcents and USD, predicted time and a remaining-budget check. Nothing is dispatched or charged. A budget the estimate would exceed is rejected with the non-retryable spend_limit_would_exceed. Default false.

tag.description: Optional spend-attribution tag (lowercase letters, digits, _ . -; max 64 chars; up to 20 active tags per organization). Usage and spend are reported per tag, and a tag with a max_spend_usd budget stops accepting new work with 402 tag_budget_exhausted once the cap is reached.

extraction_schema.description: JSON schema for structured extraction. Fields matching this schema are extracted from the page. Example: { "title": "string", "price": "number" }. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

mode.description: Scraping mode: auto (recommended), html, js (headless browser), pdf, or ocr
